programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty - it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret - it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the World's Longest Hair Village, to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy.From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty,...

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there's the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there's plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou's tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an Emporium of the World!

programme.title: Four Faces of Muqam
programme.desc: Muqam is a performing art with its roots in the folklore of Xinjiang. Rather like an encyclopedia, Muqam is a record of the history and lifestyle of the local Uygur people. It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is an integral part of Xinjiang culture, a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon - one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai's Yushu Prefecture is one of China's key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders' daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: Four Faces of Muqam
programme.desc: Muqam is a performing art with its roots in the folklore of Xinjiang. Rather like an encyclopedia, Muqam is a record of the history and lifestyle of the local Uygur people. It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is an integral part of Xinjiang culture, a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas.

programme.title: Clothing woven in the mountains
programme.desc: In Longsheng, southern China, ethnic communities have lived for generations among the same mountains and rivers. The landscape of terraced fields stretches across the valleys, carrying layered cultural memories. In this episode, CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipino singer Eliza Arce travel to Huangluo Yao Village. Beginning with the Red Yao tradition of sun-drying clothes, they explore the colours, craftsmanship, and everyday wisdom woven into these garments. Their journey culminates in a vibrant bonfire gathering, where different communities come together in celebration.

programme.title: Foodwise: Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group's lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master's skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang's story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge...

The performance requires fine muscle coordination to maintain the position of the trident around the performer's hands, neck, or back. If not controlled effectively, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: Into Guilin's landscapes: A new way to experience rural China
programme.desc: Guilin in south China's Guangxi region has long been celebrated for its breathtaking karst landscapes. Today, more and more travelers are discovering the region in a different way. Instead of simply admiring the scenery, they immerse themselves in it through cycling, hiking, bamboo rafting or via ferrata, experiencing the countryside from a new perspective. Supported by convenient transport links and a thriving outdoor recreation industry, Yangshuo County in Guilin is emerging as a global magnet where nature, culture and local life converge. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they explore Yangshuo through a variety of outdoor adventures.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group's lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master's skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang's story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge...

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or flying trident, is a performance art requiring great strength and balance, using what was historically one of the 18 main weapons of war. The performance requires fine muscle coordination to maintain the position of the trident around the performer's hands, neck, or back. If not controlled effectively, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On November 9, 2011, the body of a man was found near the Courcelles-le-Comte cemetery (Pas-de-Calais).

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to 16-year-old Karine Schaaff is found abandoned on the side of a road in Moselle; 10 days later her body is found just kilometers away, hidden in a forest.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear; there are many theories surrounding this mysterious case.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest; the police are perplexed by the clues found at the crime scene and the state of the body which is missing both the head and heart.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year-old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a car accident while on his honeymoon; Marc's wife, Aurore, isn't injured in the accident and the case is quickly dismissed; Marc's family is suspicious of Aurore.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 52-year-old Marina Ciampi is found dead at her home in Marseille; she is found naked on her bed with a plastic bag over her head, but there is no trace of a break-in; police investigate several unknown DNA traces.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On 1 December 2005, Dominique Aubry, a wealthy widow, is found hanged in her houseboat in Neuilly; the case is quickly classified as a suicide, but this argument is problematic.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente are called to a fire at a large house in the village; they arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, 83-year-old Claude Tavernier, lying in a large pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 18-year-old Laetitia Perrais is a trainee hotel waitress who vanishes after an evening shift; every attempt is made to shed light on her disappearance and the efforts eventually pay off.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, The Devil's Plateau. What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending Teknival in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written DIRTY RAPIST. Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: That Old Black Magic
programme.desc: Crichton and Crais's spirits are captured by Maldis, who thrives on hate. Zhaan takes a dark path to fight.

programme.title: DNA Mad Scientist
programme.desc: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew and promises to use it to find their home planets.

programme.title: They've Got A Secret
programme.desc: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute and gets ejected into open space.

programme.title: Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.desc: John and Aeryn avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole while flying his ship near a high flare sun.

programme.title: The Flax
programme.desc: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.

programme.title: Rhapsody In Blue
programme.desc: Z'han joins her own people, but one of them wants something from her and will do almost anything to take it.

programme.title: Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

programme.title: Durka Returns
programme.desc: Moya collides with a Nebari ship. Durka is on board and has been mind cleansed. He now serves the Nebari.

programme.title: A Human Reaction
programme.desc: Moya travels through an unstable wormhole that appears to lead to Earth.

programme.title: Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Moya tries to starburst to prove herself but it goes wrong when she gets split into several dimensions.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: A peacekeeper ship approaches Moya, so Crichton and Aeryn pose as peacekeeper officers on a secret mission.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Aeryn has been critically wounded. She needs some tissue samples to heal. The only source is the Secret base.

programme.title: The Hidden Memory
programme.desc: Scorpius attempts to extract the wormhole technology from Crichton's mind. Aeryn mounts a rescue operation.

programme.title: Bone To Be Wild
programme.desc: The crew find a planetoid that's a paradise occupied by a scientist and a girl. But one is a killer.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: Moya's crew say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before trying to save Moya and her baby.

programme.title: Mind The Baby
programme.desc: Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them.

programme.title: Vitas Mortis
programme.desc: D'Argo does a sacred ritual to help an old Luxan survive. He draws energy from Moya making her age rapidly.

programme.title: Taking The Stone
programme.desc: Chiana leaves Moya and goes to 'grave planet' populated by thrill seekers who play life threatening games.

programme.title: Crackers Don't Matter
programme.desc: A visitor comes on Moya with a device that could cloak Moya and everyone starts acting paranoid.

programme.title: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Chiana finds a recording with Moya's prior Pilot. Pilot orders Aeryn to leave after realizing she was there.

programme.title: Picture If You Will
programme.desc: Chiana buys a picture which is more than it seems. The picture shows Chiana what will happen to her.

programme.title: Home On The Remains
programme.desc: The crew needs food. Zhaan needs to eat meat and starts spewing spores. Only Aeryn can tolerate the spores.

programme.title: Dream A Little Dream
programme.desc: After the Gammak base is destroyed, Zhaan is on trial for murder. Chiana and Rygel act as her defense lawyers.

programme.title: Out Of Their Minds
programme.desc: An alien ship fires a weapon at Moya. The blast causes everyone's consciousness to jump into another body.

programme.title: My Three Crichtons
programme.desc: Crichton is cloned into a version who is a de-evolved 'cave man' and another who has increased mental ability.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 1: A Kiss Is But A Kiss
programme.desc: Princess Katralla, cannot ascend unless she finds a mate genetically compatible to her poisoned DNA.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 2: I Do, I Think
programme.desc: The Queen offers Crichton a choice; marry her daughter or she'll turn him over to Scorpius.

programme.title: Look At The Princess, Part 3: The Maltese Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton faces 80 years as a statue. The Scarran Cargn decapitates the statue and drops the head into acid.

programme.title: Beware Of Dog
programme.desc: The crew bring aboard an alien tracker to remove some creatures that came aboard hidden in some cargo.

programme.title: Won't Get Fooled Again
programme.desc: Crichton returns to Earth. Or has he always been on Earth? Is this some trick, if so who is behind it and why.

programme.title: The Locket
programme.desc: A time distortion traps Aeryn and John to live out the rest of their lives. On Moya it's only a few hours.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Crais and Talyn return. The crew are put on trial for an attack that Talyn made on an alien ship.

programme.title: A Clockwork Nebari
programme.desc: A Nebari group come aboard Moya and attempt to mind cleanse everyone using a drug.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 1, A Not So Simple Plan
programme.desc: Stark helps the crew with a plan to steal money from a depository to free D'Argo's son, Jothee, from slavery.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 2, With Friends Like These
programme.desc: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programme.desc: The crew breaks into the depository to free Crichton with the help of Talyn's unexpected arrival.

programme.title: Die Me, Dichotomy
programme.desc: The crew meets with a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns and remove Crichton's neural chip.

programme.title: Season Of Death
programme.desc: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, while Scorpius tries to avoid discovery. Zhaan makes a personal sacrifice.

programme.title: Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.desc: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew escapes the other ship and wormhole. Things are complicated when their new 'friends' sabotage Moya.

programme.title: Different Destinations
programme.desc: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool back in time where they alter the timeline.

programme.title: Eat Me
programme.desc: Crichton lands his transport pod on a dying leviathan full of cannibals and a scientist who can create clones.

programme.title: Thanks For Sharing
programme.desc: Moya rendezvous with Talyn who is seriously hurt. D'Argo and Rygel try to find Clorium, a drug to help Talyn.

programme.title: Green Eyed Monster
programme.desc: Talyn is swallowed by a boodong, leaving Stark and Rygel stranded in a transport pod.

programme.title: Losing Time
programme.desc: Moya's crew starts blacking out and missing portions of time. Pilot becomes inhabited by another entity.

programme.title: Relativity
programme.desc: Talyn lands on a planet covered with healing plants. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship to find Xhalax.

programme.title: Incubator
programme.desc: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: Talyn wants to fly into a sun. While near it Stark is contacted by an alien woman being held against her will.

programme.title: Scratch N Sniff
programme.desc: Pilot forces Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana to take a holiday as he is fed up with their bickering.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.desc: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.desc: Jack unlocks Crichton's wormhole knowledge so they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

programme.title: Revenging Angel
programme.desc: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world.

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aeryn leaves to grieve on a planet. She spots someone who might be her father but not all reunions are happy.

programme.title: Fractures
programme.desc: Escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have returned from Talyn.

programme.title: I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research. They must board the command carrier and destroy it from within.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

programme.title: Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground. D'Argo destroys a Leviathan that attacks other ships.

programme.title: Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks. They must stop the magnetic storm on Arnesk.

programme.title: Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: The crew is enroute to meet with Moya. They eat Noranti's concoction and raiders entomb Rygel in amber.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Everyone reunites on Moya. Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims he saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

programme.title: Natural Election
programme.desc: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programme.title: John Quixote
programme.desc: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: In 1854, Jeb Stuart, George Custer and other graduates from West Point are posted to Kansas to help pacify the territory before railroad construction to Santa Fe can resume.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: A disgraced Confederate colonel deserts and escapes into the Everglades, joining four other Southern deserters. Surrounded by hostile Seminoles, the group must navigate the treacherous swamp while confronting both nature and their inner demons in a tense fight for survival.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programme.desc: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak. Our black-clad hero soon has a price on his head and must try to proof his innocence with the help of his shabby friend Buddy Ben.

programme.title: My Gun is the Law
programme.desc: In San Felipe, bandits target gold meant for the railroad - until a decoy chest thwarts them. When newcomers arrive, a masked gunman begins sabotaging the outlaws. But the real mastermind may be the town’s respected leader, hiding treachery behind wealth and charm.

programme.title: Lightning Jack
programme.desc: Lightning Jack Kane is an Australian outlaw in the wild west. During a bungled bank robbery he picks up mute Ben Doyle as a hostage. The two become good friends, with Jack teaching Ben how to rob banks, while they plan Jack's last heist.

programme.title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil
programme.desc: Scotty is hired to eliminate a gang of Mexican bandits led by El Condor. He cleverly earns their trust to trap them—but as he bonds with El Condor, a true friendship and mutual respect begin to challenge his mission.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: What could be worse for two cavalry officers than to battle with native tribes? To battle each other for the same woman.

programme.title: Four Gunmen of the Holy Trinity
programme.desc: Arms trafficking with the Indians on the one hand and acquiring documents concerning the ownership of a goldmine on the other are the principal interests of Quin and Gomez, the highly suspicious guests at Papa Martinez' inn.

programme.title: The Red Pony
programme.desc: A ranch boy is gifted with a colt, grows to love him but the colt escapes, with tragic results.

programme.title: Dead Men Don't Count
programme.desc: Two gunmen ride into a town with a plan to collect a large unearned bounty but are caught up in the local war for land caused by the impending arrival of the railroad.

programme.title: The Over-the-Hill Gang Rides Again
programme.desc: Retired Texas Ranger Nash Crawford re-assembles his former Ranger outfit from the old days to fight crime in his hometown.

programme.title: God Is My Colt
programme.desc: A Army agent goes undercover to clean up corrupt Langford City full of Mexican outlaws.

programme.title: To Hell and Back
programme.desc: Johnny King, a rebellious drifter, sets out to avenge the death of his mentor and friend, Steve, after he has been murdered for his land by the Ward Brothers.

programme.title: Buddy Goes West
programme.desc: Two outlaws, The Doctor and the Indian Girolamo, help a village fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff who has discovered gold beneath the town.

programme.title: Man Who Cried for Revenge
programme.desc: Davy Flanagan, a former Union officer who was part of an attempt to break out of a Confederate prison camp during the Civil War and suffered a blow to the head that left him with amnesia. Then a bounty hunter shows up to collect a bounty on his head as a deserter.

programme.title: Secret of Captain O'Hara
programme.desc: Captain O’Hara saves Mary from Navajo warriors and brings her safely to Fort San Antonio. But her fiancé, Major Brooks, is not only O’Hara’s rival but also a ruthless enemy of the Native tribes. As tensions rise, O’Hara must fight for peace while facing personal betrayal and growing conflict.

programme.title: Gunman of One Hundred Crosses
programme.desc: An Irishman is killed in the wild West. His son Jimmy goes out searching for the killers of his father, but is soon ambushed by two highwaymen, and killed, too.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: The eldest daughter of a pioneer family is kidnapped by a mysterious Indian tribe and the eldest son pursues. In order to win back his sister's freedom, he must sacrifice his own life by passing the test of Crooked Sky and shield his sister from an executioner's arrow. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

programme.title: Arizona Colt Returns
programme.desc: Famed gunman Arizona Colt is sent by Moreno to rescue his daughter from the grips of Arizona's old enemy, Keane. But certain complications make the mission far more dangerous than expected.

programme.title: Twenty Paces to Death
programme.desc: A young half-breed is saved from death and raised as a son by his rescuer. Years later, love and betrayal tear the family apart when he falls for his adoptive sister, while a vengeful woman plots the downfall of the man who once saved them both.

programme.title: $1,000 on the Black
programme.desc: Twelve years ago, Sartana framed his brother Johnny for murder and stole his girlfriend. Now the town's undisputed boss and doted over by his possessive mother, Sartana seems safe - until, his sentence served, Johnny rides back into town.

programme.title: Incredible Rocky Mountain Race
programme.desc: An old man observes a boy bullying his playmates and treats him to a morality lesson. The man tells the story of the epic cross-country race between a young Mark Twain and his rival, Mike Fink.

programme.title: The White, the Yellow, and the Black
programme.desc: In the 19th century, when the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians but Sheriff Gideon aided by an inept Japanese servant offers to deliver the ransom.

programme.title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
programme.desc: Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punitive mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran.... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, despite the philosophy of forgiveness he has been taught, plans to take revenge.

programme.title: Alive or Preferably Dead
programme.desc: Two brothers, Monty and Ted, will inherit $300,000 if they manage to live together for six months.

programme.title: Apache Gold
programme.desc: Construction of the Great Western Railroad sparks conflict with neighboring Native American tribes. Gang leader Santer manipulates the rail route through sacred Apache land to seize a hidden gold mine. Surveyor Old Shatterhand uncovers the plot and seeks out the Apaches in a desperate effort to prevent war.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Wealthy rancher G.W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.

programme.title: White Fang and the Gold Diggers
programme.desc: Sandy Shaw inherits the Eagle's Nest gold mine in Canada's wild north. With his son Rick and dog Whiskey, he faces Taft, a ruthless rival eager to claim the mine. When Sandy’s proxy bride arrives, the clash of greed, revenge, and betrayal turns deadly in this fight for survival.

programme.title: The Shakiest Gun in the West
programme.desc: A pardoned stagecoach robber, becomes government agent and marries a naive unsuspecting east-coast dentist in order to join a wagon train.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a simple farmhand must get help from a group of wild misfits and find treasure before the outlaw he's been impersonating finds him.

programme.title: The Great Jesse James Raid
programme.desc: Retired outlaw Jesse James, under an alias, reluctantly joins Bob Ford for a Colorado gold raid. Assembling a crew, including a demolition expert and a getaway driver, they meet at Ford's saloon. Betrayals and bloodshed follow, with Ford plotting against Jesse for a reward. The drama peaks as lives are lost and the two ride off in separate directions.

programme.title: Three Ruthless Ones
programme.desc: The Walker brothers - one a criminal, another a U.S. Marshal, and the third a wealthy rancher - share a lifelong goal: to avenge their father’s murder, witnessed as children. When they finally track down the killer, their clashing ideals lead to a dramatic and inevitable showdown, testing family bonds and justice itself.

programme.title: The Jackals
programme.desc: Bad bank robber falls in love with granddaughter of miner he and his men planned to rob of gold, has change of heart.

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Stranger Lee Barton rides into Rainbow Valley, mistaken for a man thought dead. As tensions rise with ruthless town boss Tom Cherry—who's after hidden gold and the affections of a local woman—Barton is drawn into violence and revenge. With a sheriff's help, he seeks justice and a new start with a boy who believes he's his father.

programme.title: Pray to God and Dig Your Grave
programme.desc: Fernando returns from exile in Texas seeking revenge for his siblings' deaths. But instead of personal vengeance, he’s driven to spark a revolution against the oppressive landowners, transforming his mission into a fight for justice and freedom.

programme.title: VEGANnotvegan
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki put a fresh spin on a beloved brunch staple, with homemade lox and bagels facing off against smoky carrot lox and high-protein bagels, all piled high with creamy spreads and classic toppings for a seriously satisfying spread.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: The Urban Vegetarian
programme.desc: Desiree Nielsen shows how salads can be a tasty main AND served warm with a grilled romaine salad.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In an A challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas makes apple fritters and fried anchovies. But how will she combine these distinct flavours in the same dish?

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini prepares traditional dishes from the Northern Italian region, Lombardy.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Chef Lauren Gulyas tests her imagination with cashews and carrots. First, she makes cashew chicken and carrot cupcakes. But how will she combine them?

programme.title: Fish the Dish
programme.desc: Meaty prawns and melt-in-your-mouth cod are on the menu as trendy chef and seafood expert Spencer Watts gets a little salty with seafood.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh gets the show on the road with her Italian- inspired Fennel Orange Salad. Seared sushi-grade tuna rests on top of a crunchy, zesty, tangy fennel and orange salad with a honey-vinegar dressing to sweeten it up! Micah Trainor's revamp? Five Spice Duck a L'Orange with a sugary caramelized orange sauce and duck fat fried potatoes - is it French? Chinese? Who knows, but it's delicious! Next, Poppy Sandler pulls off a vegetarian variation, with a Roasted Veggie Bouillabaisse, complete with musky morels, umami-packed kombu, and tender asparagus. Missy Hui finishes up with her Orange Licorice Panna Cotta - aromatic orange blossom honey and licorice-like fennel pollen make the dish a decadent denouement to this episode of Up the Dish!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. programme.title: Bonacini's Italy

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy

programme.desc: Erland on töissä pikkupaikkakunnan paperitehtaassa parhaan ystävänsä Sven-Erikin kanssa. Vapaa-aikana hän pitää seurakunnan avioliittokoulua yhdessä vaimonsa Mayn kanssa. Eräissä juhlissa Erland rakastuu tulisesti Sven-Erikin vaimoon Kariniin.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Kauas pilvet karkaavat kertoo helsinkiläispariskunnasta. Raitiovaununkuljettaja ja perinteikkään ravintola Dubrovnikin hovimestari menettävät työnsä, mutta eivät toivoaan Aki Kaurismäen (Le Havre) Suomi-trilogian ensimmäisessä osassa.

programme.title: Blue Jasmine
programme.desc: Jasmine (Cate Blanchett, Benjamin Buttonin uskomaton elämä, 2008, Elisabet Kultainen aikakausi, 2007) pintaliitää New Yorkin runsaudensarvessa ei ole mitään, mitä luottokortilla ei saisi.

programme.title: A Cry In The Dark
programme.desc: Tässä mukaansatempaavassa draamassa eletään vuotta 1980, ja Chamberlainin perhe suuntaa telttaretkelle Australian suosituimman turistinähtävyyden, Ayers Rockin, läheisyyteen erämaahan – matka, joka muuttaa heidän elämänsä ikuisesti. Pääosissa Meryl Streep ja Sam Neill!

programme.title: Talo jossa kello tikittää
programme.desc: Talo jossa kello tikittää kertoo taianomaisen tarinan 10-vuotiaasta Lewisistä, joka muuttaa enonsa luokse vanhaan, narisevaan taloon, jonka uumenissa tikittää mystisesti.

programme.title: Colossal
programme.desc: Kun jättiläisolennon kuullaan tuhoavan Soulia, nainen Yhdysvalloissa tajuaa liittyvänsä jollain tavalla ilmiöön. Hän kamppailee ymmärtääkseen, miksi hänen vähäpätöisellä olemassaolollaan on niin suuri vaikutus koko maailmaan.

programme.title: Ringu
programme.desc: On olemassa huhu videonauhasta, joka on kirottu. Se, joka katsoo videon, kuolee tasan viikon kuluttua. Kun toimittaja Reiko tutkii kertomuksia salaperäisestä videosta, hänen sisarentyttärensä kuolee äkilliseen sydänvikaan.

programme.title: To Rome With Love
programme.desc: To Rome With Love on yhteen maailman hurmaavimmista kaupungeista sijoittuva kaleidoskooppinen komedia, jota tähdittävät mm. Alec Baldwin ja Penélope Cruz sekä elokuvan ohjaaja Woody Allen. Tutustumme mm.

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho on kansainvälinen agentti, joka on ollut mukana vaikka missä: takaa-ajoissa, räjähdyksissä, putoamisissa. Ne eivät kuitenkaan ole mitään verrattuna hänenseuraavaan tehtäväänsä: hänen pitää hoitaa tyttöystävänsä kolmea kakaraa!

programme.title: 7 Days In Entebbe
programme.desc: Todellisten tapahtumien inspiroima 7 Days in Entebbe kertoo lentokoneen kaappauksesta Air Francen lennolla 139 Tel Avivista Pariisiin vuonna 1976 ja sitä seuranneesta uskaliaasta pelastusoperaatiosta.

programme.title: Laitakaupungin valot
programme.desc: Laitakaupungin valot kertoo yövartijana työskentelevästä Koistisesta, joka joutuu petoksen uhriksi. Laitakaupungin valot oli mukana vuoden 2006 Cannesin elokuvajuhlien kansainvälisessä kilpasarjassa. Elokuva palkittiin parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnolla vuonna 2007.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Perustuu tositarinaan neljästä ulkopuolisesta, jotka näkivät sen, minkä isot pankit, media ja valtionhallinto kielsivät: maailmantalouden romahtamisen. Rohkea sijoittaminen johtaa heidät pankkialan pimeälle puolelle, jossa kaikki on kyseenalaistettava.

programme.title: Autumn in New York
programme.desc: Will Keane on viittäkymppiä lähestyvä menestyvä newyorkilainen ravintoloitsija ja parantumaton naistenmies. Mies purjehtii suhteesta toiseen - kunnes hän kohtaa nuoren Charlotten. Vielä kokematon Charlotte on sulaa vahaa maailmanmiehen käsittelyssä, mutta romanssi saa tylyn lopun.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Siltojen alla asusteleva alkoholisti Matti (Matti Pellonpää) on saamassa Amerikan tädiltään huomattavan perinnön, mutta miehen tulisi olla edustuskelpoinen tädin vierailun ajan. Matti kertoo tilanteesta autokauppiaana työskentelevälle ystävälleen, joka ehdottaa korvausta vastaan roolien vaihtoa.

programme.title: Stronger
programme.desc: Stronger on inspiroiva tositarina Jeff Baumanista, tavallisesta 27-vuotiaasta miehestä, josta tuli toivon symboli vuoden 2013 Bostonin maratonin pommi-iskun jälkeen.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai on hurmaava taiteentuntija ja nautiskelija, jolla on kalliit elämäntavat. Hän ryhtyy yhdessä brittiläisen MI5-tiedustelupalvelunkanssa etsimään varastettua maalausta.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: Vaughn tarvitsee rahaa sairaan tyttärensä hoitokuluihin. Yhdessä kollegansa Coxin kanssa Vaughn yrittää ryöstää rahat häikäilemättömältä kasino-omistajalta, The Popelta.

programme.title: Child's Play (2019)
programme.desc: ”SE”-elokuvan tuottajien CHILD’S PLAY on täysin uusi versio pahasta Chucky-nukesta kertovasta kauhuklassikosta. Chuckyn äänenä kuullaan Mark Hamill.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: Slevin joutuu vahingossa keskelle New Yorkin pahimpien rikollispomojen Rabbin ja Bossin veristä sotaa. Slevinin kannoilla pyörivät lisäksi sinnikäs poliisi Brikowski ja pahamaineinen tappaja Goodkat. Hänen on keksittävä viheliäinen juoni päästäkseen heistä ennen kuin on itse mennyttä.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Jake Green on aina liikkunut vähän epäilyttävissä porukoissa. Hän on ammattimainen korttihai, joka saa kutsun saapua kovaotteisen gangsterilordi Machan pelipöytään.

programme.title: Ruotsalainen Avioliitto
programme.desc: Erland on töissä pikkupaikkakunnan paperitehtaassa parhaan ystävänsä Sven-Erikin kanssa. Vapaa-aikana hän pitää seurakunnan avioliittokoulua yhdessä vaimonsa Mayn kanssa. Eräissä juhlissa Erland rakastuu tulisesti Sven-Erikin vaimoon Kariniin.

programme.title: Arvottomat
programme.desc: Arvottomat on ajaton kuvaus siitä kuinka Pikkurikollinen Manne, maalaispoika Harri ja kaunis Veera ajavat Volgalla läpi suomalaismaisemien, poliisien ja gangsterien roikkuessa herkeämättä kintereillä.

programme.title: Murha vailla syyllistä
programme.desc: Vuonna 1924 mediamoguli William Randolph Hearst kokosi joitain maailman tunnetuimmista persoonallisuuksista jahtinsa matkalle, joka johti vielä ratkaisemattomaan, hiljaiseen murhaan.

programme.title: Aika ei anna armoa
programme.desc: Denzel Washington on pääosassa tässä mukaansatempaavassa trillerissä. Hän esittää pikkukaupungin poliisipäällikköä, joka joutuu myrskyn silmään tutkiessaan salaa tapailemansa naisen murhaa… koska kaikki todisteet viittaavat häneen!

programme.title: The Mothman Prophecies
programme.desc: Journalisti John Klein ja hänen vaimonsa Mary joutuvat kohtalokkaaseen onnettomuuteen. Vaimon kuoleman jälkeen Johnin pakkomielteeksi muodostuvat Maryn sairaalassa tekemät luonnokset, jotka kuvaavat tummaa, siivekästä hahmoa.

programme.title: Rape And Revenge, Part 1
programme.desc: When McCall is raped by a South American diplomat immune from prosecution, Hunter follows him to his homeland.

programme.title: Rape And Revenge, Part 2
programme.desc: Against departmental orders, Hunter goes to South America to stalk a diplomat who raped McCall.

programme.title: Million Dollar Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall pursue a security guard turned thief as he searches for the money he stole and lost.

programme.title: The Big Fall
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall realize they're attracted to each other as they protect an endangered witness.

programme.title: Waiting For Mr. Wrong
programme.desc: Hunter becomes involved with a beautiful model he suspects of complicity in a jewelry robbery.

programme.title: Think Blue
programme.desc: Hunter helps a policeman who is framed for the murder of his wife.

programme.title: Blow-Up
programme.desc: Hunter pursues a package bomber whose ruthless methods are being used to kill the participants in his trial.

programme.title: War Zone
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall work to stop a brigade of suburban mercenaries plotting to break a drug dealer out of prison

programme.title: Burned
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall are given 72 hours to find an attorney who falsified his death.

programme.title: Scrap Metal
programme.desc: When a dying contract killer confesses he was paid to kill Hunter's father, Hunter pursues the true murderer.

programme.title: Fagin 1986
programme.desc: A teenager's death leads Hunter and McCall to a Fagin who commands a group of barrio boys to commit crimes.

programme.title: 62 Hrs. Of Terror
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate a student terror group in the car bombing of a Middle-Eastern consulate member.

programme.title: Death Machine
programme.desc: Hunter investigates a theft turned murder when a robbery victim hires a detective to retrieve stolen jewels.

programme.title: The Setup
programme.desc: Wrongly suspended from the force for beating a suspect, Hunter pursues the gangster who had him discredited.

programme.title: The Beautiful And The Dead, Part 1
programme.desc: When a dead girl disappears from Hunter's living room, he and McCall follow a trail of intrigue and murder.

programme.title: The Beautiful And The Dead, Part 2
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall's investigation into adultery and homicide pits them against a group of Russian spies.

programme.title: The Return Of Typhoon Thompson
programme.desc: Hunter and Dee get a murder case reopened in order to exonerate a paroled ex-boxer and find the real killer.

programme.title: Saturday Night Special
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate mysterious calls to a reporter about a series of murders.

programme.title: Overnight Sensation
programme.desc: Hunter attempts to apprehend a vicious robbery suspect while he clashes with a vindictive reporter.

programme.title: Change Partners And Dance
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall must work individually after they are separated as partners by their new precinct leader.

programme.title: Crime Of Passion
programme.desc: While investigating a homicide, McCall falls in love with the prime suspect - the victim's husband.

programme.title: The Castro Connection
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall attempt to break a cocaine syndicate apparently being run by one of Hunter's ex-partners.

programme.title: High Noon In L.A.
programme.desc: Hunter receives a death threat from a quick-tempered foreign official determined to avenge his brother's death

programme.title: From San Francisco With Love
programme.desc: A police detective aids in solving a series of murders connected to the estate of a deceased millionaire.

programme.title: True Confessions
programme.desc: The search for a vengeful woman suspected of murdering two men involved in her sister's cocaine-related death.

programme.title: Love, Hate And Sporty James
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall try to protect their informant, Sporty James, after he blackmails a ruthless cocaine dealer.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall's kidnapping-homicide investigation is thwarted by a rich industrialist.

programme.title: The Cradle Will Rock
programme.desc: McCall masquerades as a nightclub singer to investigate the disappearance of a rock music star.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: The malicious leader of paramilitary neo-Nazis take Hunter and McCall captive while planning their next attack

programme.title: Down And Under
programme.desc: Hunter goes to Australia to help solve a murder involving a former girlfriend who's been missing for 3 years.

programme.title: Straight To The Heart
programme.desc: Hunter falls in love with a beautiful professional killer who's connected to an arson case he's investigating.

programme.title: Requiem For Sergeant McCall
programme.desc: McCall is charged with murder when the prime suspect in her dead detective husband's case is found dead.

programme.title: Double Exposure
programme.desc: Sergeant McCall poses as a fashion model to expose a burglary ring preying on wealthy businessmen.

programme.title: The Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall pose as spouses to investigate the murder of a girl whose death exposes a Soviet plot.

programme.title: Any Second Now
programme.desc: A concert pianist is paralyzed by fear when a man jailed for her attempted murder is released from prison.

programme.title: A Child Is Born
programme.desc: A musician helps search for the assailant of a pregnant woman being kept alive until she can give birth.

programme.title: Crossfire
programme.desc: McCall fears that Hunter's temper will outweigh his judgement when his former girlfriend is murdered.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit, Part 1
programme.desc: McCall is shot and paralyzed after learning about a prostitution ring operating in a fleet of motor homes.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit, Part 2
programme.desc: As doctors prepare to operate on McCall, Hunter races to find whoever is killing potential witnesses.

programme.title: Shades
programme.desc: When Hunter disappears during an investigation, McCall and her new partner must find him before he's killed.

programme.title: Not Just Another John Doe
programme.desc: A murder, but the victim seemingly never existed, and the killing appears to be professionally done.

programme.title: Playing God
programme.desc: After the murder of a crime boss, Hunter and McCall face an ethical dilemma: arrest the killer or let him go.

programme.title: The Jade Woman
programme.desc: Hunter helps a distressed war buddy look for the kidnappers of his mail-order bride - CHARLES HALLAHAN stars.

programme.title: Flashpoint
programme.desc: Racial tensions mount after the accidental shooting of the son of a Hispanic councilman by police.

programme.title: Night On Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall spend a frightening night in a remote mansion with a family of murder suspects.

programme.title: City Of Passion, Part 1
programme.desc: Erik Estrada guest stars as a tough-minded detective who joins Hunter and McCall to catch a serial rapist.

programme.title: City Of Passion, Part 2
programme.desc: A serial rapist known as Big Foot stalks McCall while Hunter investigates the death of a teenage prostitute.

programme.title: City Of Passion, Part 3
programme.desc: McCall fails to report a felony, and Hunter tries to trap the killer of a teenage prostitute.

programme.title: Turning Point
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate the death of a reporter and uncover a plot involving a wealthy industrialist.

programme.title: Hot Prowl
programme.desc: Suspicion arises when a Bel Air housewife refuses to identify the man who stole her million-dollar necklace.

programme.title: Allegra
programme.desc: Investigating the death of Hunter's former girlfriend - did she jump or was she pushed from a highrise window?

programme.title: Renegade
programme.desc: When Hunter investigates a drug ring, his ex-partner becomes a suspect in the murder of the dealers.

programme.title: The Black Dahlia
programme.desc: Detective Doyle helps investigate the real life murder of an actress-turned-prostitute who was cut in half.

programme.title: Naked Justice, Part 1
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate the death of a famous actress and meet her sister, hungry for the inheritance.

programme.title: Naked Justice, Part 2
programme.desc: Investigating the murder of a famous actress, Hunter follows a killer to Mexico, and learns of CIA interest.

programme.title: Girl On The Beach
programme.desc: Captain Devane investigates his ex-wife's murder and violates his forced leave of absence to pursue the killer

programme.title: The Bogota Million
programme.desc: A Colombian drug dealer is murdered, and police informant Sporty James becomes the prime suspect.

programme.title: Death Signs
programme.desc: The investigation of the stabbing of a deaf man hinges on clues the man gave in sign language before he died.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: The wife of a dead businessman becomes the prime suspect when it's discovered she was removed from his will.

programme.title: The Fourth Man
programme.desc: Hunter investigates the missing money from an old bust that implicates the police in criminal activity.

programme.title: Murder He Wrote

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - Ireland
programme.desc: It’s the birthplace of Halloween, but the ghosts and ghouls which have canvassed the world have not scared up much interest in Irish cuisine. Mounting a classic motorcycle Jonathan tours a land of mystic traditions, boisterous locals, and iconic scenery. The world’s most magnetic pub culture draws him in, border conflict pushes him out, and dark legends pull him around. It’s an adventure soaked in rain, lore, and the food of ancestor’s past.

Through the historical turmoil and harsh climate, Russia has lost it’s traditional way of cooking, and eating. But the country is reviving this culture; Jonathan ventures the far stretches of the country to learn about modern cooks, as well as ancient kitchens housing the one key tool that gave birth to true Russian cuisine, the Russian oven. He’ll learn their insights, understand their efforts, and work with traditional Russian ingredients to learn what the cuisine used to be, and where it’s headed today.

programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: A Little Something For Your Birthday
programme.desc: Aloitteleva muotisuunnittelija kamppailee menestyksen ja rakkauden löytämiseksi. Tarina sijoittuu hänen elämäänsä kerran vuodessa, aina samana päivänä: hänen syntymäpäivänään.

programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: Leo Palamino on epäonnistunut kirjailija, josta tuli tiskaaja. Nyt hänet tunnetaan ex-vaimon pitämästä blogista “Miksi olet paska”, josta on tullut suuri hitti. Sitten Leo tapaa Coletten, unelmiensa naisen… päivänä, jona Colette on menossa naimisiin täydellisen miehen kanssa.

programme.title: Alvin Ja Pikkuoravat 3
programme.desc: Lomailevat pikkuoravat ja tyttötrio muuttavat luksusristeilijän omaksi leikkikentäkseen kunnes he haaksirikkoutuvat syrjäiselle saarelle.

programme.title: Majava
programme.desc: Majavasta voi olla apua sinullekin! Walter Blackin huumori on yhtä mustaa kuin hänen sukunimensä. Töissä menee huonosti, vaimo on saanut tarpeekseen ja poika vihaa isäänsä.

programme.title: Peace, Love And Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Komedia menestyksekkäästä newyorkilaisesta asianajajasta (Catherine Keener), joka tuo mukanaan kaksi vilkasta teini-ikäistä lastaan hippiäitinsä (Jane Fonda) luo maalle perhelomalle.

programme.title: Never Too Late
programme.desc: Neljä Vietnamin sodan vankileiriltä selvinnyttä veteraania päättää suorittaa viimeisen pakonsa - vanhainkodista. Pakosuunnitelman työstäminen seniilissä porukassa tuo kuitenkin omat haasteensa.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards on onneton nuori mies, joka kärsii vastakaiuttomasta rakkaudesta ja haluaa epätoivoisesti muuttaa elämänsä. Hän solmii sopimuksen paholaisen kanssa, ja tämä lupaa toteuttaa hänen toiveensa – mutta sillä on hintansa.

programme.title: How To Be A Latin Lover
programme.desc: Maximolla on unelma: hän haluaa tulla rikkaaksi tekemättä päivääkään töitä. Hän opettelee viettelemään rikkaita, vanhempia naisia ja päätyy naimisiin reilusti vanhemman naisen kanssa.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Newyorkilainen työhullu kustannustoimittaja Jackie seuraa poikaansa Los Angelesiin. Poika haluaa jättää opiskelut sikseen ja elää unelmaansa Kaliforniassa, missä myös äidillä on pian edessään tyrskyjä ja kuohuja.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Kun lähetti toimittaa vahingossa kätkettyjä kokaiinitiiliä sisältävän paketin väärään osoitteeseen, hän käynnistää tapahtumasarjan...

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Ben elää turvallisen tavallista keski-ikäisen elämää, johon kuuluu vaimo, talo ja haave omasta lapsesta. Eräänä päivänä oven taakse ilmestyy Andrew, vanha kaveri opiskeluajoilta, jonka taiteilijaelämä on kulkenut aivan toista rataa.

programme.title: Madness in the Method
programme.desc: Jason Mewes ei halua olla vain Jay and Silent Bobin Jay. Hän ottaa avukseen elokuvantekijä Kevin Smithin jäljittääkseen kirjan, joka voisi tehdä hänestä vakavan ja kunnioitetun näyttelijän. Sitä hän ei kuitenkaan tajua ottaa huomioon...

programme.title: Thanks for Sharing
programme.desc: Päällepäin ympäristökonsultti Adamilla, yksityisyrittäjä Mikellä ja ensiapulääkäri Neilillä ei ole mitään yhteistä, mutta he kaikki ovat mukana 12 askeleen ohjelmassa kohti vapautta riippuvuuksistaan.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Yes, God, Yes
programme.desc: Keskilännessä 2000-luvun alussa varttuva 16-vuotias Alice on aina ollut hyvä katolilainen, mutta kun viaton nettikeskustelu muuttuu rohkeaksi, hän löytää masturboinnin ja on syyllisyyden riivaama.

programme.title: I Love You Phillip Morris
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva komedia mallikansalaisesta Steven Russellista, jonka radikaalilla elämänmuutoksella on hintansa. Patologisen valehtelijan munaukset vievät miehen suoraan kaapista häkkiin, kun hän jää luksuselämänsä rahoittamiseen kehitetyistä superhuijauksista kiinni rysän päältä.

programme.title: The Female Brain
programme.desc: Mikä saa naisen swaippaamaan oikeaan herra Väärän ja vasempaan herra Oikean kohdalla? Suoraviivainen neurologi Julia tutkii miesten ja naisten aivojen eroja, jotka esitellään kolmen eri suhteen vaiheessa olevan pariskunnan elämän kautta.

programme.title: Fanboys
programme.desc: Joukko Star Wars -faneja matkustaa Skywalker Ranchille varastaakseen kopion elokuvasta The Phantom Menace, jotta heidän kuolemansairas ystävänsä ehtisi nähdä sen ennen sen ensi-iltaa, joka on vasta usean kuukauden päästä.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai on hurmaava taiteentuntija ja nautiskelija, jolla on kalliit elämäntavat. Hän ryhtyy yhdessä brittiläisen MI5-tiedustelupalvelunkanssa etsimään varastettua maalausta.

programme.title: Joe - jokapaikan höylä
programme.desc: Kun lempeäluonteinen nynny, Joe, haastaa toimiston kiusaajan tappeluun, hän lakkaakin olemasta muiden silmissä mitättömyys.

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: Rantakaupunkilomallaan 14-vuotias Duncan vieraantuu äidistään, joka pyrkii päättäväisesti saamaanuuden parisuhteensa toimimaan.

programme.title: Break Point
programme.desc: Darren on rahapulassa ja Jimmy haluaa tehdä paluun tennismaailman huipulle. Siispä he päättävät lyöttäytyä yhteen, perustaa uudelleen nuoruutensa nelinpeliparin ja pyrkiä Grand Slam -turnaukseen karsintojen kautta.

programme.title: Eagle vs Shark
programme.desc: Lily on ujo pikaruokaravintolan tarjoilija, joka kirjoittaa kappaleita, kun kukaan ei kuule. Hän on rakastunut pelikaupassa työskentelevään Jarrodiin.

programme.title: Madness in the Method
programme.desc: Jason Mewes ei halua olla vain Jay and Silent Bobin Jay. Hän ottaa avukseen elokuvantekijä Kevin Smithin jäljittääkseen kirjan, joka voisi tehdä hänestä vakavan ja kunnioitetun näyttelijän. Sitä hän ei kuitenkaan tajua ottaa huomioon...

programme.title: Drew-setä
programme.desc: Nuori joukkueen omistaja ja DREW-SETÄ (NBA-tähti Kyrie Irving) kokoavat Drew'n entisen koripallojoukkueen jälleen kasaan todistaakseen, että kuusikymppisistä koostuva joukkue voi yhä voittaa mestaruuden.

programme.title: Colossal
programme.desc: Kun jättiläisolennon kuullaan tuhoavan Soulia, nainen Yhdysvalloissa tajuaa liittyvänsä jollain tavalla ilmiöön. Hän kamppailee ymmärtääkseen, miksi hänen vähäpätöisellä olemassaolollaan on niin suuri vaikutus koko maailmaan.

programme.title: Lowlife
programme.desc: Kun helppo elinvarkauskeikka menee pieleen, kohtalon oikku yhdistää kolme yhteiskunnan unohtamaa hylkiötä: Monstruon, meksikolaisen painijan, joka toimii rikospomon turvamiehenä.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad elää mukavaa elämää Sacramenton esikaupungissa mukavan vaimonsa ja poikansa kanssa. Reissulla vanhaan opiskelukaupunkiinsa, Bostoniin, Brad ei malta olla vertaamatta elämäänsä opiskelukavereihinsa.
